purpose: Define portable case study detail content before any framework migration.

caseStudies.title: SEIS Foundation
caseStudies.summary: Clean architecture, asset curation, calm motion, and mobile-first quality gates for the new SEIS digital experience.

narrative.context: Legacy creative material is preserved as metadata and curated assets before implementation debt enters the clean app surface.
narrative.challenge: The product needs a premium cinematic identity without dependency bloat, visual chaos, or inaccessible motion.
narrative.response: A dependency-light static shell, governance registry, curated asset layer, low-motion controls, and release checks establish the foundation.
narrative.nextStep: Expand this into deeper editorial case study sections after the content model stays stable.

assetStrategy.futureSurface: editorial detail pages with narrative tags and accessibility notes

contentQualityRubric.expectation: The case study explains what changed without hiding behind abstract branding language.
Each claim points to a registry, public surface, or lightweight check.
Motion, language, keyboard, and cognitive-load notes are visible before release.
Future framework or route work can be deferred without losing the content model.

accessibilityNotes: primary story remains real HTML text
low-motion mode must preserve full content access
case study cards and future detail links must stay keyboard reachable

deferredUntilModelStable: heavy visual transitions between case studies
